text: SiteHeader takes `service` (`HeaderService`: name, optional mark and href). A `variant="portal"` masthead that passes it gets its phone layout below 768: the accessibility bar, then the department's Lockup 2 complete (Government of India, Ministry, Department, as DBIM 5.2.2 requires) with BETA as a 45° corner sash, then a 56px working bar (menu, the service's own mark — the emblem only where it has none — and name, bell, account). The masthead follows the reader's gesture: scrolling down takes it away, any upward scroll brings back the accessibility bar and the working bar together, and focus in the header holds it, all by transform with no reflow. The UX4G floating button is hidden on these pages; the bar's icon is the one door (accessibility-entry-point.md 4b). E-Anudaan is the first portal on it; tablet and desktop are unchanged. The single-row phone masthead keeps the Government of India line again; the masthead's icon controls stay outlined at every width; the accessibility bar keeps "Government of India" on one line on a phone
